verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Canny letting a product manager score ideas on value, risk, impact, confidence, or effort. The "ARR impact across ideas" MCP mention is a revenue-analysis query, not a scoring model. The "Custom Fields" item is only a developer-docs page title with no content tying it to prioritization scoring. The axis clearly applies to a feedback and roadmapping tool, so the lack of evidence yields "none".

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can score feedback and ideas using fields like value, risk, impact, confidence, and effort
